credit.credit-words: Work, for the Night Is Coming
WORDS: Anna L. Coghill, 1854; alt. by Lowell Mason, 1864. MUSIC: “Work Song”; L. M., 1864. Public Domain.

The Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave... to every man his work. Mk. 13:34 I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work. Jn. 9:4
